create_offline_tool_search: create an OfflineToolSearch instance with a list of tools to search through
call_search_tools_by_query: call the OfflineToolSearch with a query string to find matching tools by keyword
match_keywords_query_tags: use _match_keywords to check if a query string matches a tuple of keyword tags
get_tool_instructions: retrieve formatted tool instructions for tools matched by a search query
register_found_tools: use the update_tools lambda in ToolOutput to register found tools into the active tool list
